common.scientific_truth: Every datum, object, relation and uncertainty must be source-grounded; conceptual elements must be labelled. No invented causal edge or result.
common.safe_output: Use the selected backend contract; no scripts, external SVG references, arbitrary execution or admission bypass.
common.physical_readability: Assess fonts and strokes at the declared physical size; pixels and a valid SVG do not establish publication readability.
common.caption_boundary: Figure titles and explanations belong outside the canvas; panel tags and short object labels are allowed.
common.format_priority: Verified venue constraints and explicit author choices apply within scope; report conflicts, retain factual/safety rules and use one font/title policy.

audit_view.evidence_status: Make source, state and limitations explicit; audit annotations are not manuscript labels.

quantitative.quantitative_axes: Use honest axes/units when encoding values, preserving all data, intervals and precision.
quantitative.uncertainty_semantics: Distinguish raw points, precomputed intervals and distributions; never invent an interval.
quantitative.fair_comparison: No misleading comparison perspective or decorative depth that distorts numerical comparison.

schematic.typed_relations: Differentiate control, data and support relations with explicit labels and evidence. Axes and APA statistics formatting are not universal schematic requirements.
schematic.sourced_depth: Spatial depth is allowed when it expresses a sourced scientific object or mechanism; renderer support must be checked.

composite.child_roles: Route each child panel independently; preserve child units and role rules.
composite.panel_argument: Specify reading order, meaningful panel relationships and stable shared semantic encoding.

optional.strict_box: Apply the explicit strict SVG box-diagram workflow, including its geometry and inspection checks.
optional.flat_minimal_muted: Use flat/minimal/muted treatment only because this profile was explicitly selected.
